content.text: NOTE: With this inspection, it can be determined whether the trouble lies within the electrical circuit or a mechanical trouble in the transmission.

content.description: Illustration showing location of ECT ECU connector under dashboard near glove box area, with shift lever position indicator

content.text: (a) While driving, check that there is respective gear change in each drive range.

items: (b) Vehicle moves in reverse in "R" range.
(c) Vehicle does not move in "N" range.

content.text: If not as specified, check the transmission.
NOTE: If a problem is indicated with the ECT even if this check is as specified, the trouble lies within the electrical circuit.
